name: Jaelyn M.
title: Fresh, Smooth, and Easy to Use
body: It feels fresh and light, absorb quickly, and leave my skin feeling smooth and clean. It don’t magically shrink pores overnight, but with regular use, my skin texture looks better. Just make sure to moisturize afterward if you have dry skin.
